subject.title: fix(compaction): retry loop can burn tokens when summarizer model is unavailable

question: Should OpenClaw accept the proposed two-consecutive-generic-fallback cutoff for staged compaction, or choose a different degraded-mode policy before landing the fix?
rationale: The fix trades token-burn prevention against retaining more session context during summarizer outages, and that cutoff is a product/session-state policy choice rather than a purely mechanical bug repair.

options.title: Accept Linked PR Cutoff

options.title: Adjust Degraded-Mode Policy
options.body: Ask the PR to use a different threshold or fallback strategy before merge if preserving later split summaries matters more than token savings.

options.title: Reject Breaker For Now
options.body: Keep current compaction behavior and close the linked PR only if maintainers decide the token-burn tradeoff is not worth the session-state change.
